senses.en: based on a false idea or unsound reasoning

example.en: His argument is fallacious because it relies on false statistics.
example.zh: 他的论点是谬误的，因为它依赖虚假的数据。

senses.en: misleading or deceptive

example.en: The advertisement made fallacious claims about the product.
example.zh: 这则广告对该产品做了虚假的宣传。

senses.en: able to be forgiven or overlooked

example.en: Being late once during a storm is excusable.
example.zh: 暴风雨中迟到一次是情有可原的。

senses.en: steady and not changing much; calm and not easily angered

example.en: The island has an equable climate all year round.
example.zh: 这座岛全年气候温和稳定。

senses.en: a school for children too young for elementary school

example.en: Our daughter started preschool last September.
example.zh: 我们女儿去年九月开始上幼儿园。

senses.en: relating to the time before a child is old enough for school

example.en: Preschool children learn best through play.
example.zh: 学龄前儿童通过游戏学习效果最好。

senses.en: a large fast warship

example.en: The navy deployed a cruiser to patrol the coast.
example.zh: 海军部署了一艘巡洋舰在海岸巡逻。

senses.en: a police patrol car

example.en: A police cruiser was parked outside the school.
example.zh: 一辆警车停在学校外面。

senses.en: the hard, flat part that covers the end of each finger

example.en: She painted her fingernails bright red.
example.zh: 她把手指甲涂成了鲜红色。

senses.en: a medical instrument used to inject or withdraw fluids

example.en: The nurse prepared a syringe for the injection.
example.zh: 护士准备好注射用的注射器。

senses.en: to clean or rinse a body part using a syringe or liquid flow

example.en: The nurse syringed the wound to clean it.
example.zh: 护士冲洗伤口以清洁它。

senses.en: completely; used to emphasize that something is fully the case

example.en: The room was perfectly quiet.
example.zh: 房间里完全安静。

senses.en: in a perfect or faultless way

example.en: She performed the routine perfectly.
example.zh: 她把这套动作完成得完美无缺。

senses.en: a number of similar things or events that come one after another

example.en: The museum is hosting a series of lectures on local history.
example.zh: 博物馆正在举办一系列关于当地历史的讲座。

senses.en: a set of television or radio programs with the same characters or subject

example.en: She watched the entire series in one weekend.
example.zh: 她用一个周末看完了整部剧。

senses.en: a set of books published together in the same style or about the same subject

example.en: The publisher released the novel as part of a new series.
example.zh: 出版社将这部小说作为新丛书的一部分出版。

senses.en: The ability to do something well, usually gained through training or practice.
senses.zh: 通过训练或实践获得的做好某事的能力；技能。

example.en: She learned the skill of woodworking from her grandfather.
example.zh: 她从祖父那里学会了木工技能。

senses.en: A particular ability needed for a job or activity.
senses.zh: 某项工作或活动所需的特定能力。

example.en: The job requires strong problem-solving skills.
example.zh: 这份工作需要很强的解决问题的能力。

senses.en: the group of people who operate a ship or aircraft
senses.zh: 驾驶船只或飞机的一组人员；全体船员或机组人员

example.en: The crew prepared the ship for departure.
example.zh: 船员们为船只启航做准备。

senses.en: an organized group of people working together
senses.zh: 一起工作的一群人；工作队

example.en: A road crew repaired the bridge.
example.zh: 一个道路施工队修复了桥梁。

senses.en: to serve as a member of a crew

example.en: She crewed on a sailing boat last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天她在一艘帆船上担任船员。

senses.en: relating to plays, acting, or the theater

example.en: He teaches dramatic literature at the university.
example.zh: 他在大学教戏剧文学。

senses.en: sudden, striking, or exciting in effect
senses.zh: 戏剧性的；急剧的；引人注目的

example.en: The city saw a dramatic rise in bicycle use.
example.zh: 这座城市的自行车使用量急剧上升。

senses.en: expressive in a way that seems exaggerated

example.en: Her dramatic sigh made everyone laugh.
example.zh: 她夸张的叹气让大家都笑了。

senses.en: The Romance language spoken in Spain and in many countries in Latin America.

example.en: She is learning Spanish at school.
example.zh: 她在学校学习西班牙语。

senses.en: Relating to Spain, its people, or its language.
senses.zh: 西班牙的；西班牙人的；西班牙语的

example.en: We enjoyed Spanish food during our trip.
example.zh: 我们在旅行期间享用了西班牙美食。

senses.en: The people of Spain, considered as a group.

example.en: The Spanish have a long history and rich culture.
example.zh: 西班牙人有着悠久的历史和丰富的文化。

senses.en: toward the east

example.en: The birds flew eastward for the winter.
example.zh: 鸟儿们飞向东方过冬。

senses.en: moving or facing toward the east

example.en: The ship took an eastward course across the ocean.
example.zh: 轮船取道向东横渡大海。

senses.en: to feel sorry or regret for something wrong one has done

example.en: He repented of his harsh words and apologized.
example.zh: 他对自己的刻薄言辞感到悔悟并道歉。

senses.en: to turn away from sin and resolve to behave better

example.en: The preacher urged the crowd to repent.
example.zh: 传道者劝诫众人忏悔改过。

senses.en: something such as a note or message that helps you remember to do something

example.en: I set a reminder on my phone to call the dentist.
example.zh: 我在手机上设了提醒，要给牙医打电话。

senses.en: something that makes you think of a past event or fact
senses.zh: 引起回忆的事物；使人想起某事的东西

example.en: The old photo was a reminder of her childhood.
example.zh: 这张旧照片让她想起了童年。

senses.en: a short written message or note, especially in business

example.en: She sent a memo to all staff about the meeting.
example.zh: 她给全体员工发了一份关于会议的备忘录。

senses.en: relating to psychiatry or the treatment of mental illness

example.en: The patient was referred to a psychiatric clinic.
example.zh: 患者被转诊到一家精神病诊所。

senses.en: the end or tip of a finger

example.en: She tapped the screen with her fingertip.
example.zh: 她用指尖轻点了屏幕。

senses.en: a small computer built around a microprocessor, designed to be used by one person at a time

example.en: The lab replaced its old microcomputers with modern laptops.
example.zh: 实验室用现代笔记本电脑取代了旧的微型计算机。

senses.en: from one side or end to the other of something

example.en: The train goes through a long tunnel.
example.zh: 火车穿过一条长长的隧道。

senses.en: by means of; because of

example.en: She got the job through hard work.
example.zh: 她通过努力工作得到了那份工作。

senses.en: from the beginning to the end; completely finished

example.en: I read the report through and signed it.
example.zh: 我把报告从头到尾读完并签了字。

senses.en: finished or having no further relationship with something

example.en: Their business partnership is through.
example.zh: 他们的商业合作已经结束了。

senses.en: at all times, on every occasion

example.en: She always takes the bus to work.
example.zh: 她总是坐公交车上班。

senses.en: continually, without change or interruption

example.en: He has always lived in the same city.
example.zh: 他一直住在同一座城市。

senses.en: used to suggest a possible alternative or comfort someone
senses.zh: （提建议或安慰）还可以，大不了

example.en: If it rains, we can always stay indoors.
example.zh: 如果下雨，我们大不了待在室内。

senses.en: in a way that produces the desired result

example.en: The new policy effectively reduced costs.
example.zh: 新政策有效地降低了成本。

senses.en: in reality; for all practical purposes

example.en: The company has effectively stopped production.
example.zh: 这家公司实际上已经停产了。

senses.en: the number 40

example.en: The room can hold forty people.
example.zh: 这个房间可以容纳四十人。

senses.en: the years of a person's life from 40 to 49

example.en: She is in her forties.
example.zh: 她四十多岁。

senses.en: able to be noticed by the senses or the mind

example.en: There was a perceptible change in his voice.
example.zh: 他的声音有一种可以察觉的变化。

senses.en: full of twists and bends

example.en: They followed a tortuous mountain road for hours.
example.zh: 他们沿着蜿蜒的山路走了几个小时。

senses.en: complicated and not direct, sometimes deliberately so
senses.zh: 迂回复杂的；拐弯抹角的

example.en: He gave a tortuous explanation to avoid admitting the truth.
example.zh: 他给出了一个拐弯抹角的解释，以避免承认真相。

senses.en: a sudden, intense attack, especially from the air

example.en: The city suffered heavy damage during the blitz.
example.zh: 这座城市在闪电式空袭中损失惨重。

senses.en: to attack or deal with something suddenly and intensively
senses.zh: 以闪电式攻击；集中突击处理

example.en: They blitzed the opponent's defence in the second half.
example.zh: 下半场他们猛攻对方的防线。

senses.en: a secure position from which progress can be made; a place to put the foot when climbing

example.en: The company finally gained a foothold in the Asian market.
example.zh: 这家公司终于在亚洲市场站稳了脚跟。

senses.en: dark, partially decayed plant matter found in bogs, used as fuel

example.en: In some regions, people burn peat to heat their homes.
example.zh: 在一些地区，人们燃烧泥炭给家里取暖。

senses.en: a tool with two joined arms used for gripping and lifting things

example.en: She used tongs to pick up the hot bread.
example.zh: 她用夹子夹起热面包。

senses.en: a device that increases the strength of an electrical signal or sound

example.en: He plugged his guitar into the amplifier.
example.zh: 他把吉他接上了放大器。

senses.en: a reddish-brown baked clay used for pots and other objects, or its colour

example.en: The plant grows in a terracotta pot.
example.zh: 这株植物种在一个赤陶花盆里。

senses.en: a system of government with total control over public and private life

example.en: The novel depicts a society living under totalitarianism.
example.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个生活在极权主义下的社会。

senses.en: to move toward the speaker or a place

example.en: Please come here for a moment.
example.zh: 请过来一下。

senses.en: to arrive or happen in time

example.en: Spring comes early in this region.
example.zh: 这个地区春天来得早。

senses.en: to originate from a place or source

example.en: She comes from a small town.
example.zh: 她来自一个小镇。

senses.en: to become or reach a stated condition

example.en: The knot came untied.
example.zh: 结松开了。

senses.en: to do something enjoyable to mark a special occasion

example.en: We celebrated her birthday with a small dinner.
example.zh: 我们吃了一顿简单的晚餐庆祝她的生日。

senses.en: to praise someone or something publicly for an achievement

example.en: The documentary celebrates the work of local volunteers.
example.zh: 这部纪录片赞扬了当地志愿者的工作。

senses.en: to perform a religious ceremony

example.en: The priest celebrated Mass at dawn.
example.zh: 神父在黎明时分主持了弥撒。

senses.en: a single fact or piece of information about something

example.en: She explained every detail of the plan.
example.zh: 她解释了计划的每一个细节。

senses.en: a small feature or part of something larger

example.en: The dress has fine details along the collar.
example.zh: 这条裙子的领口有精致的细部。

senses.en: to give full information about something

example.en: The report details the causes of the accident.
example.zh: 报告详细说明了事故的原因。

senses.en: cured meat from a pig, often fried and eaten hot

example.en: He cooked bacon and eggs for breakfast.
example.zh: 他做了培根和鸡蛋当早餐。

senses.en: to make a hole in something with a sharp pointed object

example.en: She pierced the lid with a needle to let air in.
example.zh: 她用针在盖子上扎了一个孔，让空气进入。

senses.en: to go through or penetrate something completely

example.en: The cold wind pierced his thin jacket.
example.zh: 寒风穿透了他那件薄夹克。

senses.en: to affect someone's emotions deeply and sharply

example.en: A sudden feeling of guilt pierced her heart.
example.zh: 一阵突如其来的内疚刺痛了她的心。

senses.en: to make a low sound of pain or discomfort
senses.zh: 呻吟；发出低沉的痛苦声

example.en: He groaned when he stood up after the long flight.
example.zh: 长途飞行后他站起来时呻吟了一声。

senses.en: to complain about something in a low, unhappy voice

example.en: Students often groan about having too much homework.
example.zh: 学生们常常抱怨作业太多。

senses.en: a low sound expressing pain, discomfort, or disapproval

example.en: We heard a groan coming from the next room.
example.zh: 我们听到隔壁房间传来一声呻吟。

senses.en: a good reason showing that an action or belief is reasonable or necessary

example.en: There is no justification for treating people that way.
example.zh: 没有理由那样对待别人。

senses.en: the act of explaining or defending one's actions or beliefs

example.en: Her justification for being late was a traffic jam.
example.zh: 她为迟到辩解的理由是堵车。

senses.en: money paid for instruction, especially at a college or university

example.en: Tuition at private universities has risen sharply in recent years.
example.zh: 近年来私立大学的学费大幅上涨。

senses.en: instruction or teaching, especially private lessons (British English)
senses.zh: 教学；辅导（多指私人授课，英式用法）

example.en: She receives private tuition in French every Saturday.
example.zh: 她每周六接受私人法语辅导。

senses.en: relating to breathing or the organs used for breathing

example.en: Smoking can cause serious respiratory problems.
example.zh: 吸烟会导致严重的呼吸系统问题。

senses.en: to have a strong desire for something

example.en: After a long hike, she craved a cold drink.
example.zh: 长途徒步后，她很想喝一杯冷饮。

senses.en: to become gradually smaller, weaker, or less

example.en: Public interest in the show began to wane after the third season.
example.zh: 第三季之后，公众对这个节目的兴趣开始减退。

senses.en: (of the moon) to appear gradually smaller each night

example.en: After the full moon, the light begins to wane.
example.zh: 满月之后，月光开始亏缺。

senses.en: a gradual decline in size, strength, or power

example.en: The empire was in a state of steady wane.
example.zh: 这个帝国处于持续衰落的状态。

senses.en: a strike by workers

example.en: The union called a walkout over pay disputes.
example.zh: 工会因薪资纠纷发动了罢工。

senses.en: leaving a meeting as a protest

example.en: Several delegates staged a walkout during the debate.
example.zh: 辩论期间几位代表退席抗议。

senses.en: a member of an English Protestant group in the 16th and 17th centuries seeking simpler worship

example.en: Many Puritans settled in New England in the 17th century.
example.zh: 许多清教徒在17世纪定居于新英格兰。

senses.en: a person with strict moral or religious views who opposes pleasure
senses.zh: 清教徒式的人；道学先生

example.en: He's such a puritan that he refuses to watch any comedy.
example.zh: 他是个十足的老派正经人，连喜剧都不看。

senses.en: to add explanatory notes to a text

example.en: Students annotated the poem to explain its difficult lines.
example.zh: 学生们给这首诗作了注解，解释其中难懂的句子。

senses.en: the player in football or hockey whose job is to stop the ball or puck from entering the goal

example.en: The goalkeeper made a brilliant save in the final minute.
example.zh: 守门员在最后一分钟做出了一次精彩的扑救。

senses.en: made official or carried out according to strict, established forms

example.en: The two sides signed a formalized agreement last month.
example.zh: 双方上个月签署了一份正式的协议。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of formalize: to make official or written down in formal form
senses.zh: 使正式化；使成文（formalize 的过去式和过去分词）

example.en: The two companies formalized their agreement last year.
example.zh: 两家公司去年将协议正式确定下来。

senses.en: a strong feeling of disgust or aversion

example.en: She felt a deep repulsion at the sight of the spoiled food.
example.zh: 看到变质的食物，她感到强烈的反感。

senses.en: the force by which objects push each other apart

example.en: Like magnetic poles exert repulsion on each other.
example.zh: 同名磁极之间相互排斥。

senses.en: a place where two rivers flow together

example.en: The city grew up at the confluence of two rivers.
example.zh: 这座城市建在两条河流的交汇处。

senses.en: a coming together of people, ideas or things

example.en: The project was a confluence of talent and opportunity.
example.zh: 这个项目是人才与机遇的汇聚。

senses.en: to strongly encourage or urge someone to do something

example.en: The coach exhorted the team to keep fighting until the end.
example.zh: 教练敦促球队坚持战斗到最后一刻。

senses.en: to make skin sore by rubbing

example.en: The tight collar chafed his neck.
example.zh: 紧领子磨痛了他的脖子。

senses.en: to feel annoyed or impatient

example.en: He chafed at the long delay.
example.zh: 他对长时间的耽搁感到恼火。

senses.en: soreness or annoyance caused by rubbing or irritation

example.en: The chafe on his heel made walking painful.
example.zh: 脚后跟的擦伤使他走路很疼。

senses.en: amounts of money paid for professional services or to join a school or club

example.en: The school raised its tuition fees this year.
example.zh: 学校今年提高了学费。

senses.en: to give someone less change than they are owed

example.en: The cashier accidentally shortchanged a customer.
example.zh: 收银员不小心少找了一位顾客的零钱。

senses.en: to treat someone unfairly by giving them less than they deserve

example.en: Schools should not shortchange students in science education.
example.zh: 学校不应在科学教育上亏待学生。
